linkedPullRequests.title: Change to fix issue #4955 - fix for multi-asic chassis_packet
linkedPullRequests.author: vperumal
linkedPullRequests.body:
### Description of PR
Proc is missing a check  to see if a system is a multi-asic system or not and hence hitting issue #4955. This fix introduces a check to see if the system is multi-asic system or not and modifies the commands accordingly. This issue causes the test crm/test_crm.py::test_crm_fdb_entry to error out.

@abdosi kindly review the fix.
